title: Plastic Waste Sorter for Recycling Bins
title_te: రీసైక్లింగ్ డబ్బాల కోసం ప్లాస్టిక్ వ్యర్థాల విభజన యంత్రం
problem: Thin plastic milk packets and water bottles get dumped together in our hostel backyard. People burn them in the open and the choking smoke fills our classrooms.
idea: A plastic sorting helper. A student shows the waste to the camera and it says which bin to use. Here you can try it by tapping what the camera sees.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: Which bin does this go in?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine looks at the waste through the webcam. Here, tap the item the camera sees.
widgets.question: A student holds this in front of the camera:

options.label: Hard water bottle
options.result: Hard plastic! Empty it, squash it and put it in the BLUE bin.
options.te: గట్టి ప్లాస్టిక్! ఖాళీ చేసి, నొక్కి, నీలం డబ్బాలో వేయండి.

options.label: Milk packet
options.result: Soft plastic! Rinse it, dry it and put it in the YELLOW bin.
options.te: మెత్తని ప్లాస్టిక్! కడిగి, ఆరబెట్టి, పసుపు డబ్బాలో వేయండి.

options.label: Banana peel
options.result: This is not plastic. Put it in the GREEN wet waste bin for compost.
options.te: ఇది ప్లాస్టిక్ కాదు. ఆకుపచ్చ తడి చెత్త డబ్బాలో వేయండి.

options.label: Someone lighting a fire
options.result: STOP! Never burn plastic. The smoke is poison for our lungs.
options.te: ఆగండి! ప్లాస్టిక్‌ను ఎప్పుడూ కాల్చవద్దు. ఆ పొగ ఊపిరితిత్తులకు విషం.

questions.q: What should we do with plastic waste?
options: Sort it and give it for recycling
questions.why: Sorted plastic can be sold to scrap dealers and recycled.
Burning plastic gives off poisonous gases that hurt our lungs.

questions.q: Before putting a milk packet in the bin, we should…
questions.why: Clean, dry plastic does not smell and is easy to recycle.

how: Open teachablemachine.withgoogle.com and choose Image Project.
Make 3 classes: Hard bottle, Soft packet, Other waste. Take about 50 photos of each with the webcam.
Click Train, then Export and copy the model link.
In PictoBlox, add the Machine Learning extension and paste the model link.
Add blocks: when class is Hard bottle, say 'Blue bin'; when Soft packet, say 'Yellow bin'.
Make colourful bin labels in Canva and stick them on the hostel bins.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Write 4 short, friendly messages in simple English and Telugu telling hostel students which bin to use: hard plastic bottles, soft milk packets, wet food waste, and a warning never to burn plastic.
